svg.title: Fig 4 — Turret, dosing disc and 2:1 drive
svg.desc: Left: top view of the turret with 8 rectangular columns on a 55 mm radius, column 0 at the front under the restock hatch, the flush 95 mm dosing disc at the front with its pocket at LOAD under column 0 and at REST outside the turret over the exit hole, and the MG90S servo with 48-tooth gear at the rear meshing the 24-tooth hub gear. Right: table and chart mapping columns 0-7 to turret angle, servo angle and pulse.
svg.text: Fig 4 — Turret, dosing disc and 2:1 drive
8 vial columns ride on a turret over a fixed floor; S1 turns it 2:1 from the rear and holds the chosen column at the front, where a flush dosing disc (S2) takes one vial.
TOP VIEW
front at the bottom · top cover removed · dashed = below the floor / under the turret

g.text: FRONT · exit chute and tray beyond

svg.text: COLUMN MAPPING — start values, calibrate each column
SERVO ANGLE VS COLUMN
157.5° of the servo's 0–180° range is used
S1 always approaches from the lower-pulse side
overshoot −50 µs, then up → gear backlash
taken up the same way every time
S1 stays powered until the disc is back at REST
then PWM off; idle hold = stack friction
+ servo gearbox (no detent)
Torque at turret = ½ servo
drag 35.6 mN·m at the turret (µ ≤ 0.2)
→ 79 mN·m at the horn, SF 2.3
No wrap-around
column 7 → column 0 sweeps back
ramp ≤ 25 µs / 20 ms, full sweep ≈ 1.4 s
Smart Med Station · Hardware design v2.1 · 2026-10-07
